items.title: Cyclosporiasis outbreak hits Taco Bell sales, unlikely to cause lasting scar, analysts say
items.summary: July 22 (Reuters) - The United States' largest foodborne illness outbreak in recent years, linked to shredded lettuce served at some Taco Bell eateries, may dent the fast-food chain's sales, but is unlikely to cause any long-lasting ‌damage to the brand, analysts said. health officials are investigating the source of the cyclosporiasis outbreak, which has sickened thousands of people in Michigan ‌and four other states.

items.title: Yum! Brands (YUM) Appoints Nai De Leon As People Chief In Leadership Shift
items.summary: Yum! Brands (NYSE:YUM) has appointed Nai De Leon as Chief People Culture Officer. She succeeds longtime executive Tracy Skeans, who is retiring after a 25-year career at the company. The transition reflects a generational change within Yum! Brands' executive leadership team. Yum! Brands, the global restaurant company behind KFC, Pizza Hut, Taco Bell and other chains, is putting fresh emphasis on its people and culture priorities with this leadership change. items.title: Lettuce Outbreak Wilts Yum Brands Stock
items.summary: Yum Brands, the parent company of Taco Bell, fell for a seventh consecutive day in the stock market. The stock closed down 0.1% at $147.17. Earlier Tuesday, Yum Brands shares traded below $146. The stock is down 10% over the past seven trading sessions, its worst seven-day stretch since 2020.
